elements.manual_reason: No candidate box isolates the mouse cursor; it travels up from the Delivery tickets label to the Create a delivery ticket button (end position given).
elements.label: Mouse cursor
Create a delivery ticket button (focus ring and hover darken)
Delivery progress row hover state (row tint and overflow menu briefly appear as cursor passes)
Expanded ticket row hover tint clears

pattern.description: Screen recording: with the ticket tree already expanded, the cursor moves up past the progress bar and lands on 'Create a delivery ticket', which picks up a focus ring as the narration turns to creating new work.
pattern.why_premium: The cursor arrives on the next call-to-action just before the narrator says 'or you can create', so the UI action and voice stay tightly synced.

build_hint.remotion: Cursor position via interpolate(frame,[start,start+12],[from,to],{easing:Easing.out(Easing.cubic),extrapolateRight:'clamp'}); hover states as frame-threshold conditionals; focus ring opacity 0->1 over 3 frames on arrival.

notes: Real UI screen recording; motion is cursor travel plus hover/focus states. Focus-ring outline is partly offset from the button in the end frame (recording artefact). No SFX candidates.
